# Syed Co.

> Syed Co. is the personal site of Taimoor Syed, an investor, consultant and entrepreneur based in Vancouver, BC. He helps Canadian organizations work out what is holding back their sales and marketing, and who is best placed to fix it. That is sometimes himself and often someone in his network.

## About Taimoor Syed

- 10+ years in sales and marketing: running campaigns, door knocking, cold calling, go-to-market strategy, CPG packaging, and most recently building with AI
- Has worked with 50+ Canadian organizations across agriculture, CPG, restaurants, healthcare, government, associations, software and service-based businesses
- Works with scaling organizations across Canada
